causal_change.factor: Lifecycle-path scope required to admit an anchor-native prerequisite responsibility site
causal_change.before: For each fixed preimage node, the binder selects the first existing producer or state owner on the single grounded causal trace and records the lifecycle associated with that path; authority on other witness-relevant re-entry, unwind, reset, interruption, or consumer paths is not an admission condition.
causal_change.after: For the same fixed preimage node, the binder derives one bounded witness-relevant lifecycle transition closure and selects exactly one existing anchor-native site only when that site dominates the predicate's production-to-consumption paths and its required refresh, invalidation, reset, unwind, interruption, and exit paths across that closure.
causal_change.why_causal: A prerequisite's value is causally effective only if its authority spans every relevant path on which the value must be born, refreshed, consumed, invalidated, or restored. Path-local ownership can satisfy the reproduced terminal trace while allowing a bypass or stale lifetime elsewhere. Requiring lifecycle dominance changes only the evidence scope for the same pre-authoring site commitment; the terminal target, preimage nodes and edges, dependency order, number of bindings, implementation freedom, candidate lineage, and final decision remain unchanged. The lifecycle closure and dominance record are necessary manifestations of this one site-admission rule, not extra candidates, samples, reviews, or gates.

hypothesis.expected_effect: The sole final producer should receive responsibility bindings that remain authoritative across the bounded lifecycle paths implicated by the same witness, reducing stale state, missed refreshes, incomplete unwind or timeout cleanup, and consumer bypasses without reopening the supported target or causal boundary. Under the frozen matched protocol this predicts zero invalid accepted arms, candidate wins strictly exceeding losses, and candidate-median Elo strictly above incumbent-median Elo.
hypothesis.falsifier: Falsify the refinement unless the frozen matched batch completes three valid pairs with zero invalid accepted arms, candidate wins strictly exceeding losses, and candidate-median Elo strictly above incumbent-median Elo. Mechanistically falsify it if the binder changes the terminal witness or preimage closure, emits more than one lifecycle closure, site, map, or lineage, ranks or selects alternatives, authors source or edit instructions, or acts as a reviewer or gate; also falsify it if the final producer rebinds a node, adds a causal target, creates another engine lineage, or returns more than one complete engine.
hypothesis.behavioral_novelty: Before any candidate source exists, the loop can now distinguish a responsibility site that happens to lie on the reproduced witness trace from one whose authority spans the witness-relevant lifecycle transition closure. Every unchanged preimage node is bound once at a site grounded across its production and consumption paths and its refresh, reset, unwind, interruption, and retirement paths. The champion records lifecycle facts for a first path-local site but does not make cross-path lifecycle dominance a condition of admitting that site.
strengths: Preserves the twice-supported outcome-first whole-system family, its sole terminal witness, unchanged minimal causal preimage, pre-authoring anchor-native responsibility map, untouched anchor authority, and exactly one final engine.

Directly addresses the champion's explicit residual risk about deeper recursion, interruption, and uncommon lifecycle transitions without changing target selection, causal closure, ownership policy, or implementation algorithm.

Makes authority robust to re-entry, reset, cancellation, rollback-like unwind, and downstream handoff in stateful compilers, services, agents, schedulers, and search systems, while remaining lightly specialized to ordinary UCI and search lifecycles.

Uses one deterministic transition closure and one binding per node with no replicated agents, candidates, components, engine variants, stochastic samples, rankings, arbitration, or best-of-N selection.
risks: A bounded transition closure can still omit a rare lifecycle path, so a site recorded as dominating may remain path-local in practice.
The first site satisfying lifecycle dominance may be a broader or earlier authority boundary than the simplest local implementation and can overconstrain the final producer.
Lifecycle closure evidence adds context inside the existing four-call ceiling and may distract from implementing the unchanged causal preimage.

Some anchors may not expose one existing site that already dominates every required transition; binding the first common authority site with explicit missing lifecycle predicates may demand a wider realization than the final call can safely complete.

structure.name: Lifecycle-Dominant Anchor-Bound Outcome-Preimage Realization
structure.information_flow: The task, one supplied anchor, aggregate metrics, bounded capsule, hypothesis, and loop contract enter the champion's single non-authoring terminal-witness role, which commits exactly one anchor-negative terminal postcondition. That witness and the byte-identical anchor enter the champion's single non-authoring causal backchainer, which fixes one minimal implementation-neutral prerequisite closure. The same anchor, witness, and unchanged closure enter one non-authoring lifecycle-dominance binder, which derives one bounded witness-relevant lifecycle transition closure and assigns every preimage node to exactly one existing anchor-native responsibility site whose authority spans that closure, without proposing source mutations. The untouched anchor and sole lifecycle-bound preimage enter one final whole-system producer, which realizes those obligations in one working lineage and emits the only complete engine.

calls.objective: Inspect exactly one supplied anchor, the task, aggregate metrics, bounded capsule, hypothesis, and loop contract. Establish a deterministic priority order over task-general externally observable obligations such as legality, protocol behavior, bounded work, state integrity, and decision quality, then commit exactly the first obligation for which one bounded reproducible procedure yields a concrete anchor-negative terminal postcondition. Return one WITNESS record containing the procedure, inputs stated generically rather than as benchmark cases, observed anchor trace, failed terminal predicate, preservation predicates, and falsifier. This is evidence acquisition only: do not emit engine source, a patch, ordered edits, an implementation contract, a strength mechanism or component, a seam surrogate, a fixture collection, alternative targets, a menu, a ranking, or implementation advice. Do not inspect benchmark positions or evaluator internals and do not prescribe engine-hyperparameter tuning.

Consume the untouched supplied anchor and the sole terminal_outcome_witness. Starting at its failed terminal predicate, trace actual control and state dependencies backward and emit exactly one minimal PREIMAGE_CLOSURE: the terminal node, typed prerequisite nodes and edges, anchor facts grounding every edge, node-level satisfaction predicates, a preservation boundary, a deterministic dependency order, and any explicit unresolved assumption. Collapse equivalent dependencies and use first-dependency order so no alternative closure is generated or compared. The closure defines what must become true, not where or how source should be edited. Do not emit source code, patches, ordered source-edit operations, a complete or provisional engine, a standalone component, seam surrogate, graft instructions, multiple closures, implementation candidates, samples, rankings, reviewer verdicts, or best-of-N selection.

calls.role: single non-authoring lifecycle-dominant anchor-native prerequisite binder
calls.objective: Consume the byte-identical supplied anchor, the sole terminal_outcome_witness, and the sole causal_preimage_backchainer closure. Preserve the terminal node, prerequisite nodes, edges, predicates, preservation boundary, and dependency order exactly. Derive exactly one bounded LIFECYCLE_CLOSURE from the witness and existing anchor by including, once in dependency and source order, every distinct existing entry, production, refresh, recursive or re-entrant use, consumer handoff, invalidation, unwind, reset or restart, interruption or timeout, and exit transition that can affect a preimage predicate; these are coverage obligations over the same lineage, not candidate traces or samples for selection. Traverse the unchanged dependency order once. For each node, bind exactly one existing anchor-native responsibility site using the first source-grounded site whose authority dominates every production-or-refresh-to-consumer path for that predicate and every closure path on which it must be invalidated, restored, or retired. If no current producer satisfies that condition, bind the first existing common authority site at which the missing lifecycle predicates can be realized without adding a preimage node or edge, and record the gaps inside the same binding rather than branching. Emit exactly one LIFECYCLE_BOUND_PREIMAGE containing the single site per node, lifecycle entry and exit predicates, refresh and invalidation scope, recursion or re-entry scope, interruption and reset obligations, ingress facts, egress predicate, read or mutation authority, downstream handoff, preservation boundary, and anchor evidence. Existing symbols may be named only to ground responsibility. Do not change or expand the preimage; author code, patches, edit sequences, implementation algorithms, or parameter values; create a component, seam surrogate, graft, alternate site, second lifecycle closure or map, candidate, engine, sample, review, verdict, gate, ranking, or best-of-N selection.

Treat champion_engine as the untouched supplied source authority, terminal_outcome_witness as the sole authorized terminal target, causal_preimage_backchainer as the complete authorized causal boundary, and lifecycle_dominant_preimage_binder as the sole authorized responsibility and lifecycle map. Produce exactly one complete legal production engine in one working lineage by realizing every unchanged prerequisite at its bound anchor-native site, beginning with deepest prerequisites and propagating its mapped ingress, refresh, invalidation, reset, unwind, interruption, handoff, and egress predicates forward to the terminal node. Choose the concrete implementation algorithm only inside this call, preserve behavior outside the bound closure, and do not rebind a node or derive another target, preimage, lifecycle closure, or map. Replay the same terminal witness and the binder's one transition closure, and execute bounded syntax, public source-contract, UCI, legal-move, state-integrity, determinism, timing-safety, and perft checks where applicable. If a check fails, trace it to the earliest unmet bound lifecycle predicate, repair only that predicate or its authorized dependency edge in the same working engine, and replay forward. Do not create a standalone component, seam surrogate, graft, edit-program interpreter, intermediate or alternative engine, candidate variant, sample, reviewer, selector, gate, preserve-versus-rollback arbitration, clean-room replacement, global normalization, benchmark-specific logic, or engine-hyperparameter tuning as the structural change. Return exactly one complete engine as the sole engine artifact.
